## Purpose and scope

What changes, why, and which issue or agreed experiment does this address? What remains out of scope?

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. Distinguish automated tests from author/owner-reported manual verification; state anything skipped or still unverified.

- [ ] Relevant code/workflow checks passed (`npm test`, `npm run check`), or this is a prose-only local review and that distinction is explained.
- [ ] Browser behavior changes were checked with suitable installed tooling, or the limitation is stated.
- [ ] Tests use synthetic data rather than real player credentials or library exports.

## Publication and review

- [ ] The complete proposed public history was reviewed and publication was authorized, including any newly exposed transcript, Git identity, or host observations.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, licensed music, private paths, catalog dumps, or temporary browser/log artifacts are included.
- [ ] Historical artifacts and unrelated work are preserved; relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Any changes to scope, dependencies, workflows/permissions, data handling, or playback behavior are called out for explicit review.

These checks do not grant permission to push, merge, change repository settings, or choose a license.
